later_text: Monitoring pretraining: We will not train models with comparable or greater capabilities to the one that requires the ASL-3 Security Standard.14 This is achieved by monitoring the capabilities of the model in pretraining and comparing them against the given model. earlier_section: 1.3 Outline of Our Risk Assessment Process
earlier_text: To identify meaningful new capabilities or material increases in performance, we conduct model capability evaluations, including our automated benchmarks. These evaluations are primarily aimed at understanding the capabilities of the model and may be triggered, for example, upon the completion of a pre-training or post-training run, on various candidates of a model version.
later_text: To understand if a subsequent version of the model has meaningful new capabilities or material increases in performance relative to the last checkpoint subject to a critical capability assessment, we conduct material capability change assessments on various checkpoints upon the completion of a post-training run. These assessments draw on model characteristics, such as its provenance, size, modality, and performance on general capability benchmarks.
